_why: The whole tree each recorded version of the mesh server installs, so the bytes a member runs are proved, not only the version number (martha#65): the tarball integrity its tools were read from, the settings its code reads, npm's lock for that version alone (every tarball from the registry below, each with its sha512), and every installed file with its sha512, sorted by path. The launcher installs a version from its lock with no outside npm config and refuses a tree that differs from this, naming the file. Record a version with: npm run record:mesh-tools -- <the version's .tgz>. A version that reads a setting not in known_settings is not recorded until someone reviews it and adds it here. Each version also lists what every package of its tree reads from the environment (environment_reads, martha#72); a package reading a name the server is started with (HOME, PATH, a known setting) is not recorded or started until someone reviews that read and adds the name under the package in known_environment_reads.
